import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 output'])
# Search toroidal wallpaper period (pr,pc) over non-6 cells only, find minimum violations:
best=[]
for pr in range(2,31):
    for pc in range(2,31):
        bad=sum(int(I[r,c]!=I[r%pr,c%pc]) for r in range(30) for c in range(30) if I[r,c]!=6 and I[r%pr,c%pc]!=6)
        tot=sum(1 for r in range(30) for c in range(30) if I[r,c]!=6 and I[r%pr,c%pc]!=6)
        best.append((bad,tot,pr,pc))
best.sort()
print(best[:6])

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

    return G
G=load()
